recommendation: Implement tool registry and catalog management
guidance: Agents that can't discover tools end up with hardcoded integrations, inconsistent documentation, and a maintenance tax that grows with every new capability. A centralized registry makes the tool catalog queryable, versioned, and governable.
how_to_check: • A centralized tool registry provides a single authoritative source for tool capabilities, current versions, and operational status. • Tool documentation is standardized and complete so agents can select and invoke tools without guesswork. • Tool versioning and compatibility tracking help prevent agents from invoking deprecated or incompatible versions. • Tool deprecation procedures remove sunset tools cleanly without disrupting dependent agents. For more information, see the AGENTOPS04-BP01 documentation.
